hero.subTitle1: Providing professional methodologies to comply with OSHA standards
hero.subTitle2: and achieve zero incidents in the workplace.

step1.title: Establish SOP
step1.desc: Establish standard JSA operating guidelines tailored to the site characteristics.

step2.title: Form Analysis Team
step2.desc: Match supervisors, safety experts, and skilled field workers.

step4.title: Execute Assessment
step4.desc: Break down steps, identify hazards, and establish safety measures.

step5.title: Review & Approve
step5.desc: Review field applicability of measures and obtain final approval.

step6.title: Follow-up Actions
step6.desc: Implement physical measures like equipment upgrades and PPE provisioning.

step7.title: Record & Train
step7.desc: Database analysis results and conduct dissemination training for workers.

step8.title: Field Application
step8.desc: Deploy the confirmed safe work procedures into actual operations.

step9.title: Performance Evaluation
step9.desc: Continuously monitor implementation and validate the effectiveness of measures.

section4.title: 4. Mandatory Items for Risk Assessment Rules

item1.title: Purpose & Method
item1.desc: Objectives and selection of site-specific techniques.

item2.title: Organization & Roles
item2.desc: Specific R&R for management and field workers.

item3.title: Target Selection
item3.desc: Comprehensive listing of all tasks and equipment.

item4.title: Timing & Frequency
item4.desc: Conditions for initial, periodic, and special assessments.

item5.title: Risk Criteria
item5.desc: Unique standards for calculating risk levels.

item6.title: Record Retention
item6.desc: Standardization of forms and retention guidelines (e.g., 3-5 years).

checklist.item1: Is there an absence of or unclear Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)?
checklist.item2: Is it a task where undesired incidents or near-misses frequently occur?
checklist.item3: Do the workers lack experience in this specific process?
checklist.item4: Does the task require a high level of skill or specialized training?

math.caption: Risk = Probability (Frequency) of occurrence × Severity of consequence
